entries.reasoning: TravelHub is caught via the extended limb of the 'Hospitality Business' definition in §1.11 because it provides distribution services to hotel owners through its booking platform. The services—AI itinerary personalization, AI hotel ranking, and a performance dashboard—constitute AI and data analytics services provided to a GCC-headquartered entity for properties in the UAE and KSA, which is restricted until September 2029.
readings: TravelHub is a Hospitality Business because its platform provides distribution services to hotel owners by listing and booking their inventory.
TravelHub is a consumer travel technology provider, and its hotel booking features are ancillary to its planning application and do not categorize it as a Hospitality Business.

incomingClauses.quote: Itinerary Personalization Engine — a recommendation service that generates personalised day-by-day itineraries using user preferences, trip purpose, budget, travel dates, past bookings and in-app behaviour, and re-ranks suggested activities, restaurants and experiences in real time

Partner Hotel Ranking Module — a ranking and recommendation service that scores, ranks and surfaces Partner Hotels in the United Arab Emirates and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia to TravelHub users at the point of search and itinerary building
Partner Performance Dashboard — a dashboard for TravelHub's partnerships team showing impressions, click-through, bookings and commission by Partner Hotel, city and ranking position

entries.suggestedChange: None; the counterparty's business model as a distributor and the nature of the AI/analytics services collide with the restricted period ending in 2029.
entries.waiverWhy: The Seaside waiver is strictly limited to one entity in Oman and specifically excludes other Hospitality Businesses and different services.
entries.impact: Directly collides with the Al Noor promise, live until Sep 2029, because TravelHub acts as a hotel distributor in the GCC.

covenants.quote: During the term and for twelve (12) months thereafter, neither Party shall solicit for employment any employee of the other Party directly involved in the Services.
covenants.impact: Standard non-solicitation of project staff; does not restrict AtliQ's ability to serve existing clients.
